senses.zh_definition: 英语专有名称；可作姓氏，例如迪士尼电影角色 Alice Kingsleigh 的姓。不具有可据现有资料确立的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: An English proper name, attested as the surname of the fictional character Alice Kingsleigh.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan, antaranya, sebagai nama keluarga watak fiksyen Alice Kingsleigh.
senses.nuances: pos 为 noun，此处具体指专有名词。输入的小写检索键予以保留，正常书写使用 Kingsleigh。现有证据支持专名用法，不能标为官方马来语普通词；马来语释义是说明性概括，并非 DBP 释义。以下为名称组合示例，不宣称是高频搭配。[迪士尼官方角色介绍](https://movies.disney.com/alice-in-wonderland-2010)。

etymology.historical_story: Kingsleigh is securely attested as a surname in Disney's presentation of Alice Kingsleigh. That establishes a naming use, but it does not establish a Malay lexical meaning or the historical origin of this particular spelling. Its appearance in Malay discussion of the film should therefore be understood as the retention of a foreign proper name. [Disney](https://movies.disney.com/alice-in-wonderland-2010)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Alice Kingsleigh 当作完整姓名记：Alice 是名字，Kingsleigh 是姓；不要给这个姓硬配马来语词义。
